title: The final page
venue: the last page of the book
logline: The bay at low tide. The chimney, the mug, the tide line, the sandpipers, the cedar branch going out.

panels.composition: A sweeping watercolor vista of Alsea Bay opening into the Pacific at low tide. Morning sun breaks through low coastal clouds, turning the wet sand into a mirror of gold and slate. Middle distance, small but sharply inked: the tackle shop's chimney smoking gently; CHLOE sitting on the wooden dock with a ceramic mug; WOOD walking the tide line with his sketchbook under his arm; BARNABY II charging headlong into a scattering flock of sandpipers. Bottom right, outside any border: the signature, dated 1997–2027, flanked by a tiny cedar branch floating out to sea.
